fields.value: Discovery call with Pampa Agro. Field reps visit about 200 dealers and report on paper, later typed into a spreadsheet, so orders and promises get lost. They want one place for visits and orders, working offline with GPS check-in, for 38 users, live by July 2027, with about USD 70,000 a year. A field demo is set for 11 Nov.

evidence.quote: After each visit the rep fills in a paper report, and on Friday someone types it into a spreadsheet.

fields.value: No mobile signal in the fields; reps are not used to apps

evidence.quote: The problem is there's no mobile signal in the fields.
And the reps are not used to apps.

fields.value: Orbita (Ana): send a short video of the offline mode by 9 Nov; Pampa: pick two reps for the field demo

evidence.quote: I'll send you a short video of the offline mode by Monday.

fields.value: Field demo with two Pampa reps on 11 Nov

evidence.quote: would a field demo with two of your reps work next Wednesday, the 11th?
I'll send you a short video of the offline mode by Monday.
I'll send you a short video of the offline mode by Monday.

fields.note: 'Monday' resolved from the meeting date, Wed 2026-11-04.

fields.value: One place for every dealer visit, order and promise

evidence.quote: We need to know which dealer was visited, what they ordered and what was promised, in one place.
About seventy thousand dollars a year.

fields.note: 'I make the final call' comes from an unattributed speaker, so the decision-maker is not identified.

evidence.quote: Thirty-two field reps in sales, and six people in the leadership team who want the reports.

fields.value: Works offline; GPS visit check-in; dealer visit and order records

evidence.quote: Then it must work offline and have the GPS check-in, those two are non-negotiable.
Our ERP is Orion ERP. The dealer orders need to flow there.
We're about four hundred and fifty people.
